trace.question: What is the average age of the male patient with high cholesterol?
trace.evidence: average age = DIVIDE(SUM(SUBTRACT(YEAR(NOW()), YEAR(birthday))), COUNT(ID)); male patient refers to sex = 'M'; high cholesterol refers to `T-CHO` > = 250;

attempts.sql:
SELECT AVG(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND p.ID IN (SELECT l.ID FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.`T-CHO` >= 250)

trace.final_sql:
SELECT AVG(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND p.ID IN (SELECT l.ID FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.`T-CHO` >= 250)
trace.answer: The average age of male patients with high cholesterol is about 71.95 years.
